name: framework-demo
description: A small back office on a React framework where requirements are held by code: component folders, injected clients and services, statecharts, and checks that name convention mistakes.

scripts.typecheck: npm run types && npm run stories --silent && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node framework/typescript/check.cjs -p .
scripts.test: node --test framework/shared/folders.test.cjs framework/shared/i18n.test.cjs framework/typescript/transform.test.cjs && vitest run
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.perf: vite build --config perf/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && node perf/cycles.mjs
scripts.perf:frames: vite build --config perf/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && node perf/frames.mjs
